symptom: When every focused-test Python candidate is rejected, the scheduler still emits sys.executable; on a Python 3.9 scheduler this preserves the datetime.UTC QA failure instead of handing remote QA a compatible command.
root_cause: _focused_test_command used Path(sys.executable) as the next() default, so the fallback bypassed _python_supports_focused_tests after that same interpreter had already failed the compatibility probe.

             for candidate in candidates
